explanation: Keep the minimum total reaching each cell of the previous triangle row. For the next row, add the smaller valid parent total, handling the two edge cells separately. Take the minimum of the final row.
timeComplexity: O(N) time for N triangle cells.
spaceComplexity: O(r) row workspace for r triangle rows.
